description: Source file implementing Android asset management functions for the Cobalt project, including initialization, teardown, and asset access utilities.

methods.name: DuplicateJavaString
methods.description: Copies characters from a jstring to a newly allocated C string buffer.

methods.name: SbFileAndroidInitialize
methods.description: Initializes Android asset management, retrieves application directories, and sets up asset manager references.

methods.name: SbFileAndroidTeardown
methods.description: Cleans up and releases resources allocated during initialization.

methods.name: IsAndroidAssetPath
methods.description: Checks if a given path is within the app's assets directory.

methods.name: IsAndroidAssetFile
methods.description: Checks if a given path points to a file within the assets directory.

methods.name: OpenAndroidAsset
methods.description: Opens an Android asset file given its path.

methods.name: OpenAndroidAssetDir
methods.description: Opens a directory within the Android assets.
